_comment: The tenant's own personal-data detectors (core README, PII; research note 05 section 1: tenant dictionaries compiled from the data layer). NATIONAL_ID: the synthetic Lebanese-style ID of the seed (LB-dddd-dddd-d), which no built-in detector knows. The dictionary: every first and family name of the people in the practice database, one whole-word term each (lib/dataset.py person_terms). No term may equal a word of the tenant's name: the guard also pseudonymises the datasource tool's arguments, which carry the ontology version <tenant>@<n> (see README, gaps), so names are protected without the NER tier and a family name alone gets the same surrogate as in a full name. E-mail addresses, French and Lebanese phone numbers and the French NIR are built in.
